backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Report mapping two UI branding features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining extensive OKLCH theme variables for light and dark mode.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting the Skynet Services page title and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app layout composing header, sections, and footer into a single page.
frontend/src/components/hooks/useContact: Custom hook managing contact form state, validation, submission simulation, and reset.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section with differentiator cards, Skynet Services branding, and stats.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section with business info and a validated contact form powered by the hook.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero area with background image, headline, CTAs, and trust metrics.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Renders a services section with cards for CCTV and broadband offerings and includes smooth scrolling to the contact section.
Displays a footer with company info, social links, quick navigation, and smooth-scrolling helpers.
Implements a responsive header with scroll-based styling, navigation links, mobile menu, and smooth section scrolling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React Query hook that creates and refreshes a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context for Internet Identity, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future backend-related React Query hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes with custom color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH color variables, extended radius and shadows, and animation keyframes. Includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, feature requirements, and architectural notes for the Skynet Services website build.
